partnership_angle: Referral partner + sandbox tester. Audit Peak is exactly the profile LoxeAI wants: a founder-led, sub-15-person boutique founded in 2021 that already audits 10-person cloud-native startups at startup-friendly prices ($15-45K Type II), holds AWS certifications, and already operates inside the Drata automation ecosystem — so recommending a readiness scan to pre-audit clients is a natural extension of how they already work. Their small size means one validated relationship converts the whole firm. Best entry: get them to run LoxeAI against a sandbox AWS account (sandbox tester), then convert to a standing referral partner for their pre-audit/readiness-assessment pipeline. Caveat: the founder is not publicly named, so the first call likely routes through Chevorne Lewis or info@/Calendly.
pitch_note: You built Audit Peak to give 10-person cloud startups Big 4-quality SOC 2 audits without Big 4 friction — LoxeAI was built for the same clients on the readiness side. It's an AWS-native scanner that maps a startup's actual AWS posture against SOC 2 criteria before the audit starts; we'd love 30 minutes to have you run it against a sandbox (or your own) AWS environment and tear it apart as an auditor. If it holds up, your pre-audit clients get a 'run this scan first — it gets you 80% ready' step that shortens your readiness assessments and sends you cleaner evidence on day one.
